user.title: Connect to Comelit Intercom
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Comelit intercom device. Token is optional - if not provided, it will be extracted automatically using the default 'comelit' password.

data_description.token: Leave empty to automatically extract using default password

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device
error.auto_token_failed: Failed to extract token automatically. Please check that the device is accessible and using the default 'comelit' password, or enter your token manually.

video_media_not_received.message: The intercom accepted the call but did not send video. Try again and check the Comelit device is not in use by another client.

video_call_failed.message: The intercom video session could not be started.

video_rtpc_not_received.message: The intercom did not open its media channel.

door_open_failed.message: The {door} control could not be activated.
